description: Prepare a print job with the area (and optionally the letter) and return reviewUrl: the link the user opens to see the area on the map, change it, upload or check the letter, and pay. Nothing is sent or charged until the user confirms there. The link is valid for 24 hours.

addresses.description: Single addresses by postcode and house number, on top of or instead of an area.

houseNumber.description: House number, optionally with letter or addition, e.g. "100", "12A", "12-1".

houseNumberSuffix.description: Letter or addition when not part of houseNumber.

bufferMeters.description: Extra margin in metres around every circle and polygon. Default 0.

circles.description: Circular areas around a place or coordinate. The simplest way to reach "the neighbours around X".

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84) of the centre, used when `place` is absent.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84) of the centre, used when `place` is absent.

place.description: Address, street, postcode or place in the Netherlands, e.g. "Keizersgracht 100, Amsterdam" or "1015CV".

polygons.description: GeoJSON Polygons with [longitude, latitude] coordinates (WGS84), outer ring closed.

letter.description: The letter: A4 portrait, top-left address window empty. Omit to let the user upload it on the review page.

contentBase64.description: The file, base64 encoded (at most 3 MB before encoding).

name.description: A name for the mailing the user recognises, e.g. "Bewonersbrief verbouwing Dorpsstraat".

name: create_print_job
title: Prepare a mailing for the user
